DK28.6 is a medical diagnosis code designating a chronic or unspecified gastrointestinal ulcer accompanied by bleeding and perforation. Within the Danish healthcare system, this code plays a specific role in monitoring patient safety and treatment outcomes for individuals diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]]. Specifically, it is utilized as part of the clinical quality indicator that tracks the incidence of severe bleeding events in this patient population [^src1].

The tracking of severe bleeding relies on a comprehensive matrix of diagnostic codes to ensure accurate quality measurement. For gastrointestinal bleeding, DK28.6 is grouped alongside other codes such as [[dk25-0|DK25.0]] through [[dk29-8a|DK29.8A]] and [[dk92-0|DK92.0]] through [[dk92-2|DK92.2]] [^src1]. The broader indicator also captures intracranial bleeding (using codes like [[di60|DI60]] to [[ds066|DS066]]) as well as urinary and respiratory tract bleeding (using codes like [[dj942|DJ942]], [[dn02|DN02]], [[dr04|DR04]], and [[dr31|DR31]]) [^src1]. These precise definitions are systematically outlined in the annual reports published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), which establish the exact numerators, denominators, and exclusion criteria for clinical quality measurements across Danish regions [^src1] [^src2].
